x: Articles and match reports: George Beecham, Gordon Doubleday, Mark Gregory, Eric Hall, Bill Laws, Bill Lucas, Alan Mead, John Powell, Clive Shippen, Steve Whorlow.

Mark Gregory reports on the inaugural European Clubs Relay Champs held in Rennes, France on September 18, 1999 Although this competition has been running for over five years, this was the first time that it had been recognised as the Official European Clubs Relay Championships.
